This page shows aggregated country-level registration counts for the Bioconductor Africa Seminar Series, which is open to participants worldwide. The series supports the growth of the Bioconductor community in Africa.

Learn more about the series: [Bioconductor Africa Seminar Series](https://training.bioconductor.org/workshops/bioc-africa-seminars/)

```{r}
source("scripts/make_registrants_map.R")
```

**Registrants:** `r total_registrants`  
**Last updated:** `r generated_on`
